text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Autoscaler alert: attempted GPU node attach failed in us-west3 (GCP DENY 403 - QUOTA). Queue length: 1287 (+200/min). p95 latency 3.2s -> 7.8s. Error spike: inference timeouts from hosted API. Pager: oncall@sara
sara: taking this. joining bridge now — oncall bridge 6732109999
mike: checking GCP quotas... looks like project-level GPU quota is at 100%, multiple attach requests denied. Confirmed deny code from GCP logs.
emma: recommendation: enable regional reroute to eu-west1 and fallback to quantized model for new requests. I'll stand up reroute and update routing policy.
raj: customer impact? any paying customers affected?
sara: 15% request error rate for /v1/generate for hosted tier; Dedicated customers unaffected. Support ticket #INC-8941 created, CS alerted.
mike: quick checks: GCP quota shows 0 free GPUs in us-west3 for project redwood-inference-prod. Uploading logs to ops bucket.
support-bot: Uploaded quota-deny logs to gs://redwood-ops/incident/6732109999/deny.log :white_check_mark: 
emma: applying routing flag now:
```
# toggle regional reroute for us-west3 -> eu-west1
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/flags/region_reroute -d '{"src":"us-west3","dst":"eu-west1","enabled":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
```
sara: enabling fallback to rwd-3b-q8 for new sessions (reduce GPU reqs). patching rollout.
mike: also reducing batch target from 64 -> 16 to lower memory pressure.
raj: I'll draft a short customer note for status page: "We're experiencing degraded inference in us-west3 due to cloud GPU quota limits; traffic is being rerouted; mitigation in progress." Want to include ETA?
sara: ETA 30-45m to stabilize after reroute. Will update every 15m. Adding postmortem owners: mike + emma.
emma: created hotfix runbook entry and triggered ephemeral reserved pool request with partner quota contact. GCP quota increase requested (ticket #123456789).
support-bot: Noted: support escalation created -> SEV2
mike: mitigation status: reroute active, fallback model live. Queue length dropping: 1287 -> 340 in 6m. Error rate down to 4%.
sara: great. move to monitoring mode. I'll push a concise customer update on status.redwood.ai/incident/6732109999
raj: posted customer-facing note. pinging sales for impacted accounts.
emma: after stabilization, we'll schedule capacity hold and quota increase to avoid recurrence. filing infra task INFRA-4123.
sara: thanks all. handoff to follow-up channel #postmortems once stable. :thumbsup:
